display.purpose: Hero/landing headlines only, 800 weight Space Grotesk.

label.purpose: Badges, eyebrow labels, tabular/numeric data, JetBrains Mono.

operational.purpose: Dense POS/KDS/dashboard screens: 10/12/13/14/16/18/20/22/24/26px, the real dominant scale on those surfaces — not the branded rem scale.

shadows.name: sm-dark
shadows.purpose: Resting card elevation in dark mode.

shadows.name: md-dark
shadows.purpose: Hover/elevated card state, dropdowns, dark mode.

shadows.name: sm-light
shadows.purpose: Resting card elevation in light mode.

shadows.name: brand-glow
shadows.purpose: The one sanctioned glow — input focus rings on the violet accent only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view. Violet background, midblack text, never white text on violet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #6835F9; background: #6835F9; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7a4dfa; border-color: #7a4dfa; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(104, 53, 249,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(104, 53, 249,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action next to a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: #111114; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #18181c; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content container, one step up from the page ground.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); transition: border-color 120ms, background 120ms; } .ds-card:hover { background: #1a1a1a; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input with the one sanctioned glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #ffffff; transition: all 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(104, 53, 249,0.08), inset 0 0 0 0.5px #6835F9; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status pill — success/warning/error/info/brand/neutral variants, never decorative.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge--success { background: rgba(36,171,92,0.16); color: #24ab5c; }

narrative.overview: Prominentz looks like a ledger book worked late on a busy floor: a mostly black-and-white operational surface — midblack (#0b0b0c, ~60% of any screen) and pure white (#ffffff, ~30%) — with one deliberate mark of violet (#6835F9, ~10%) reserved for the thing that's actually live or actionable right now. Nothing about it should read as decorative; every accent use is a signal, not a flourish. The system was built to be read correctly by someone mid-shift, not admired at rest — precise and unshakeable rather than warm or playful. The system explicitly rejects gradient text, glow effects, and multi-hue decoration. A prior pass had the primary accent faked via background-clip: text on hero copy even where the underlying value was a single flat color — that's been corrected to a plain color assignment; gradients-as-decoration have no place here.
keyCharacteristics: Mostly monochrome (black/white), with a single reserved accent color used sparingly
Real, layered drop shadows for depth (not flat/tonal) — confirmed as the standard, not legacy
Crisp, unambiguous component states: color changes, not soft/ambiguous affordances
Dense, operational typography (Space Grotesk display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for labels/mono contexts)
Same accent and ink pairing holds in both dark and light mode

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only accent color in the system. It appears only on primary buttons, active/selected state, and focus rings — never as a secondary decorative color, never doubled up with another accent. Does not apply to the Operational palette, which is real product status color, not decoration.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from shadow weight and layering, never from a colored glow except as a deliberate, sparing focus-ring treatment on the violet accent itself. Don't add decorative glow to anything else.

rules.name: The Two-Scale Rule
rules.body: Branded/marketing surfaces use the --text-* rem scale; operational/POS/KDS/dashboard surfaces use the px-based Operational Scale (10/12/13/14/16/18/20/22/24/26px). Don't mix them on the same screen, and don't convert one into the other.

dos: Do keep violet (#6835F9) reserved for primary actions and active/focus state only — never decorative.
Do use Ledger Black (#0b0b0c) as the dark-mode ground and the light-mode ink; don't introduce a second "almost black."
Do keep real layered box-shadows for elevation in both themes — this system is not flat/tonal.
Do use midblack text on violet backgrounds, never white — it's a contrast requirement, not a preference.
donts: Don't fake colored text with background-clip: text / gradient tricks — set color directly.
Don't add a second accent color alongside violet on the same screen.
Don't soften button/input radii below the md (6px) step.
Don't let sidebar/nav "current" states borrow the violet accent — that's reserved for actions, not location indicators.
Don't recolor the Operational palette (error/success/warning/expo/muted) to brand colors — they're real product status, not decoration.
Don't invent a third type scale or radius scale for new operational work — reuse the documented Operational Scale and Operational radius steps.
Don't use overshoot/bounce easing (cubic-bezier with a value above 1) anywhere — it contradicts the system's "precise and unshakeable" character.
